changeSet.author: trendai
changeSet.comment: Backfill user profiles with statistics from existing generated images
changeSet.sql: -- Update total_generations and calculate XP from existing generated_images UPDATE user_profiles up INNER JOIN ( SELECT user_id, COUNT(*) as total_gens FROM generated_images WHERE status = 'COMPLETED' GROUP BY user_id ) gi ON up.user_id = gi.user_id SET up.total_generations = gi.total_gens, up.total_xp = gi.total_gens * 10, up.current_xp = (gi.total_gens * 10) % GREATEST(1, up.level * up.level * 100), up.level = LEAST(100, GREATEST(1, FLOOR(SQRT(gi.total_gens * 10 / 100)) + 1));

-- Update total_favorites from favorite_images UPDATE user_profiles up INNER JOIN ( SELECT user_id, COUNT(*) as total_favs FROM favorite_images GROUP BY user_id ) fi ON up.user_id = fi.user_id SET up.total_favorites = fi.total_favs;

-- Update unique_trends_used UPDATE user_profiles up INNER JOIN ( SELECT user_id, COUNT(DISTINCT trend_id) as unique_trends FROM generated_images WHERE status = 'COMPLETED' GROUP BY user_id ) trends ON up.user_id = trends.user_id SET up.unique_trends_used = trends.unique_trends;

rollback.sql: UPDATE user_profiles SET total_generations = 0, total_xp = 0, current_xp = 0, level = 1, total_favorites = 0, unique_trends_used = 0;
